criteria.description: Module 1 SHALL add a reading section, "Claude can do more than answer you."
criteria.evidence: WP02 review (cycle 1, approved): new content section present in js/data/modules/01-get-oriented.js, 4 short paragraphs matching the module's existing plain-language tone/length; live-verified rendering in browser before the new lab.

criteria.description: Module 1 SHALL add a new lab, "Would you allow this?", 5 permission requests judged Allow/Don't allow/Not sure, with explanations.
criteria.evidence: WP01 review (engine explanation-field support) + WP02 review (both approved): module-1-permission-check quiz lab has exactly 5 items, 3 options each, correctIndex values verified byte-for-byte against data-model.md; live-verified explanations render for both correct and incorrect answers.

criteria.description: Module 3 SHALL broaden its four unsafe-data categories with two more, a "when in doubt" rule, and a safe-to-paste example.
criteria.evidence: WP03 review (approved): two new categories, "when in doubt, don't paste" rule, and a contrasting safe example all present in js/data/modules/03-data-safety.js, matching the module's existing category shape; live-verified rendering and 360px layout.

criteria.description: Module 3 SHALL add a closing section, "Sometimes the right answer is: don't use AI at all."
criteria.evidence: WP03 review (approved): closing section present, covers all six situations named in the WP, framed as judgment-building; existing module-3-spot-mistake lab confirmed untouched.

criteria.description: Module 4 SHALL add a before/after change-review section, not a Git course.
criteria.evidence: WP04 review (approved): new section grepped for "diff"/"commit"/"commit history" as taught concepts, found none; before/after example and embedded reflection questions present; live-verified at 360px.

criteria.description: Module 6 SHALL add "A good prompt doesn't guarantee a good answer," cross-referencing Module 8.
criteria.evidence: WP04 review (approved): section present with the "AI output is a draft until you've checked it" rule; cross-reference to Module 8's actual "Treat the first reply as a draft" wording verified accurate by reading that file directly.

criteria.description: Module 8 SHALL add a "Verification checklist" section (6 questions).
criteria.evidence: WP05 review (approved): all 6 questions present, explicitly framed as a second rule set alongside Module 6's golden rules; source facts confirmed as visible reading content before the lab.

criteria.description: Module 8 SHALL add a graded "Can you spot what's wrong?" lab with 3 planted inaccuracies.
criteria.evidence: WP01 review (engine explanation-field support) + WP05 review (both approved): module-8-verification has exactly 3 items (wrong date, invented task, wrong number), each independently identifiable against the source facts; existing module-8-quiz confirmed byte-identical/untouched.

criteria.description: Module 11 SHALL add a recovery-workflow section, not a Git course.
criteria.evidence: WP06 review (approved): section clearly separated with its own heading; grepped for "commit"/"branch"/"revert" as taught concepts, found none; "keep a way back" rule confirmed as one plain sentence, not a tutorial.

criteria.description: Module 11 SHALL add a "Something went wrong" lab modeling diagnose-before-fixing.
criteria.evidence: WP01 review (engine explanation-field support) + WP06 review (both approved): module-11-recovery is the first lab entry, 4 options, correctIndex 2, explanation verified byte-for-byte against data-model.md; existing module-11-prompt-builder confirmed untouched.

criteria.description: Module 12 SHALL add a non-blocking "Before you start" readiness self-check, not a checklist-lab.
criteria.evidence: WP07 review (approved): confirmed the module-12-download lab's labs array is byte-for-byte unchanged (still exactly one download lab, two entries); zero interactive elements in the new HTML; live-verified both downloads remain reachable without interacting with the new section.

negative_invariants.description: This mission SHALL NOT add a new module, or change any existing module's id/order/purposeKey (C-001).

negative_invariants.description: This mission SHALL NOT introduce a new lab engine type (C-002).
negative_invariants.evidence: All three new labs (Modules 1, 8, 11) reuse type: "quiz" via the WP01-extended quiz-lab.js; no new js/views/labs/*.js file was created.
